about: 10CL016 routing switch (PIP) bits, translation-pooled (routemap.py pooled) from 1,900 two-LE builds labelled with quartus_sta report_timing -show_routing (routes.py). Key: (from type, from index, from x - to x, from y - to y, to type, to index); for LUT inputs the index is 'slot.port'. Value: [instances, [[frame offset, row-space offset], ...], anchor]; anchor 'to'/'from' = which end's (x, y) the bits are relative to: frame = LUT frame 0 of LE N0 in column x (lutpos) + offset; row-space index = lutpos.ROW[y] low byte + PLANE_START[plane] + offset. Keys with 1-4 bits, LUT-cell positions removed. 5-fold cross-validation (routemap.py cv): ~2,245 keys per fold; all predicted bits present in 98.92% of held-out uses (48768/49300), absent in 99.77% of held-out non-uses (661430/662933). Coverage: 76% of fabric hops in the corpus; I/O (periphery) hops and ~1,300 keys with no or too many candidates are not covered. Offline only.
